initialExam.title: IBPS SO (Specialist Officer) 2026
initialExam.description: IBPS Specialist Officer exam for IT, Agriculture, HR, Marketing, Law, and Rajbhasha officers in banks.
initialExam.syllabus: Prelims: English (30Q), Reasoning (50Q), Quantitative (50Q). Mains: Professional Knowledge (60Q) specific to specialization.
initialExam.examPattern: Prelims: 130 questions, 150 marks, 2 hours. Mains: 60 questions, 60 marks, 45 min. Interview: 100 marks.
initialExam.careerGrowth: SO → Senior Manager → Chief Manager → AGM → DGM → GM.
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit ibps.in 2. Register 3. Select specialization 4. Fill form 5. Pay fee 6. Submit
